source.normalization: Original pieces have unit circumradius, so cube edge length is 1.1547005383792517; centers divided by this edge. Apply a proper rigid rotation to align ALL published tetrahedron outer vertices with the project canonical solid (normalized discrepancy 2.08e-15). Fit piece rotations to ALL source mesh vertices (maximum discrepancy 2.06e-15). Convert container circumradius into edge ratio R/(0.61237243569579447 * 1.1547005383792517). Add standard 1e-7 clearance without transferring discovery credit.
